harness.next.label: Next start
harness.next.hint: `daoris agent profile use {{agent}}` prints the steps the next start follows
harness.next.whyGoal: Each start walks this list: driven work passes the account kept for conversations, and an account whose limit is reached, that draws on usage credits or whose use is over its curve goes last, the least over first; then the account running the fewest of Daoris's sessions, then one whose week resets within a day, then the one with the most room under its curve, then the one Daoris started on least recently, then the order. The first ready account runs: not cooling, not refused, and signed in.
harness.next.whyGoalOff: Each start walks this list: driven work passes the account kept for conversations, and an account whose limit is reached, that draws on usage credits or whose use is over Daoris's curve goes last, the least over first; then the account running the fewest of Daoris's sessions, then one whose week resets within a day, then the one furthest behind its week's pace, then the one Daoris started on least recently, then the order. The first ready account runs: not cooling, not refused, and signed in.
harness.next.whyOrder: Each start runs on the first ready account in the order, begun at its first; an account whose limit is reached, that draws on usage credits or whose use is over its curve goes last. Driven work passes the account kept for conversations.
harness.next.own: The next start runs in the tool's own home, which is nobody's sign-in: nothing here names an account.
harness.next.noAccount: No Daoris account is signed in for it; its starts wait until you sign in.
harness.next.waitsUntil: None of Daoris's accounts is ready, so the next start waits until {{when}}.
harness.next.waits: None of Daoris's accounts is ready, and none comes ready by itself: the next start waits for you.
harness.next.signInSooner: Signing in to {{accounts}} starts it sooner.
harness.next.newKeySooner: A new API key in place of {{accounts}} starts it sooner.
harness.next.newKey: A new API key in place of {{accounts}} starts it.
harness.next.why.named: it is the only one of Daoris's accounts
harness.next.why.onlyReady: it is the only one of Daoris's accounts that is ready
harness.next.why.keptOver: {{over}} is kept for conversations, which take it last
harness.next.why.near: {{over}} has reached its limit, draws on usage credits or is over its curve, so it goes last
harness.next.why.nearReached: {{over}} has reached its {{window}} limit, so it goes last
harness.next.why.nearCredits: {{over}} is drawing on usage credits, so it goes last
harness.next.why.nearOver: {{over}} is over its curve on its {{window}} window, so it goes last
harness.next.why.fewest: it runs fewer of Daoris's sessions than {{over}}
harness.next.why.lapsing: its week resets {{when}}, with more of it left to spend before then
harness.next.why.lapsingSoon: its week resets within a day, with more of it left to spend before then
harness.next.why.lapses: its {{window}} window resets at {{when}} with {{unused}} of it unused, as read at {{seen}}
harness.next.why.pace: it is further behind its week's pace than {{over}}
harness.next.why.room: it has more room under its curve than {{over}}
harness.next.why.leastRecent: Daoris started on it less recently than {{over}}
harness.next.why.notStarted: Daoris has not started on it yet
harness.next.why.listFirst: it comes first in the order
harness.next.why.listNext: it comes before {{over}} in the order
harness.next.held.keyRefused: {{account}} was refused, so it needs a new API key put into it
harness.next.held.near: {{account}} has reached its limit, draws on usage credits or is over its curve
harness.next.held.nearOver: {{account}} is over its curve on its {{window}} window
harness.next.ownSignIn: {{product}}'s own sign-in, the account it uses at your terminal, carries none of these starts, which run only on Daoris's accounts.
